1998: "Reverso has been active since 1998, with the aim of providing high-quality online translation and linguistic tools to corporate and mass markets." (source#History))
2013: "In 2013 it released Reverso Context, a bilingual dictionary tool based on big data and machine learning algorithms." (source#History))
2016: "In 2016 Reverso acquired Fleex, a service for learning English via subtitled movies." (source#History))
2018: "In 2018 it released a new mobile app, which combines translations and learning activities." (source#History))

2018: "In February 2018 it was reported that some translations on the Reverso translation web site returned antisemitic results, such as "Much nicer" returning "Dachau was much nicer than Auschwitz"." (source#History))
Best traffic rank recorded on Wikidata: 277 (2019-08-01), the best of 1 recorded ranks (Alexa)
"Reverso's suite of online linguistic services has over 96 million users, and comprises various types of language web apps and tools for translation and language learning." (source#Services))
"Its tools support many languages, including Arabic, Chinese, English, French, Hebrew, Spanish, Italian, Turkish, Ukrainian and Russian." (source#Services))
"Since its founding Reverso has provided machine translation tools for automated translation of texts in various languages, including neural machine translation." (source#Services))
